question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a bundled dashboard widget authoring SDK/templates guide after the Wave 1 dashboard stack lands, or should the starter/gallery material live outside core?
rationale: Current main lacks the dashboard widget substrate, and the decision affects public contributor docs, builtin widget contracts, and custom-widget browser trust guidance.

options.title: Defer Until Wave 1 Lands
options.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow follow-up and write docs/templates only against the merged dashboard widget contract.

options.title: Sponsor Concurrently
options.body: Allow the guide to evolve alongside the open dashboard PR stack, accepting churn if the API changes during review.

options.title: Move Samples To ClawHub
options.body: Document only the core extension points in OpenClaw and put example widget/template packages in ClawHub or an external sample repository.

recommendation.title: Defer Until Wave 1 Lands
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow follow-up and write docs/templates only against the merged dashboard widget contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current bundled Control UI tab seam and is the strongest current-main owner signal for the UI/plugin boundary decision.
